proves.facet: Compiles every launcher role with and without a parent and requires the parent-routed developerQuestions sentence for all six parentable roles while the parentless value stays byte-identical.

The compiled ownerRelation requires leaf peer arguments, no routine parent result and current-Manager role/task returns. Coordinating roles retain named developer-needed categories/final-report duties and captured starter provenance, not byte-identical addressing text. Parentless relation equality is separately asserted; this case is not native delivery or the developerQuestions-ID discriminator.

1.note: The handover test asserts Paseo and agents-remember-task host fields, the role_start/role_message tool names, scoped reader-discovery instructions and held/permission wording. The parentless control requires no invented parent; a started role records its actual starter and role/task return address.

2.note: The first-message control rejects forbidden host strings across generated role prompts. The description control checks three role-agent tool descriptions—role_start, role_message and role_start_set—and separately checks user_settings_init; no stored description or first-message assertion proves host delivery.

Host acceptance or consuming-turn completion is distinct from AR acceptance; the source check remains separate from live message delivery. These are source assertions/support behavior, not a fresh invocation, host result or AR acceptance.
